A small '''village''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coveway]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Coveway)|commander]] of an [[Unidentified Imperial garrison (Coveway)|Imperial garrison]] on Coveway ordered the destruction of the village.<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
